symptom: Owner iPhone Safari reaches READY_GOOGLE / WP 27/27, then Cesium throws RangeError: Invalid array length and rendering stops.
root_cause: At stopTime sampleOnce() requests pos.getValue(currentTime + 0.55). Beyond the final SampledPositionProperty sample this returns undefined, code falls back to n=p, producing a zero forward vector. Normalizing that zero vector creates an invalid camera orientation at the exact end of flight.
evidence_path: aumara/index.html sampleOnce(): const t2 = currentTime + 0.55; const n = pos.getValue(t2) || p; normalize(n-p). ClockRange is CLAMPED at intro+dur, so this is reproducible at WP27.
exact_patch: Introduce const flightEnd = intro + dur and let tickHandler = null before sampleOnce().
Inside sampleOnce compute atEnd = elapsed >= flightEnd - 0.02.

For camera tangent: if not atEnd, use future position at min(elapsed+0.55, flightEnd). If atEnd, use previous position at max(elapsed-0.55, 0) and set direction = p - prev. Never normalize a vector with magnitudeSquared < 1e-12 or non-finite components.
Only call viewer.camera.setView when direction/up/right/look are finite and direction magnitudeSquared >= 1e-12. Otherwise leave the previous valid camera orientation unchanged.

When WP27/atEnd is reached the first time: set ended_at, viewer.clock.shouldAnimate=false, clamp currentTime=stopTime, remove tickHandler from viewer.clock.onTick, and set window.__AUMARA.flightComplete=true.
Register tickHandler as a named function/reference instead of anonymous onTick lambda so it can be removed cleanly.
Do not change any Cesium tile LOD, SSE, clipping, blend, GLB, AR, georef or UI logic in this patch.

acceptance.owner_iPhone: Google render survives through WP27 and stays rendered for >=30 seconds after WP27

stop_rule: Patch only the end-of-flight tangent/tick lifecycle. Commit and stop for owner proof.
